steps.detail: Create isolated task assets/image files, capture original scenes and canonical library file hashes, write explicit source bindings, enable the identical bridge mailbox for a 60-minute task resource lease.

Use manifest.isolatedConsoleRoot as an isolated test document library and source-bindings.json as DevRoomSyncService(source_bindings=...). Keep the production catalog unchanged. Real preview/import creates Console identities; real UI reads the device document, uploads manifest.uploadImagePath, and edits title/summary/section body/caption. Real push returns the request UUID.
Invoke production ProcessCurrentSessionRequests, not an alternate apply or fabricated receipt.

Read actual request and receipt files; verify request/nonce/project/source identity, saved asset/meta/content/parent/image/structure hashes, actual Texture2D reference, and decoded source/imported GPU pixel hashes. Image first section must be the uploaded fixture.
Repeat the same production-mailbox scan; require asset bytes, filesystem write time and receipt bytes unchanged.

Run before any other Editor operations. Refuse unless the current Undo group/name exactly equal this applied receipt. Undo must restore original text/caption/GUID/fileID; Redo must restore confirmed content and actual GPU pixels. Save only the task asset afterward.

Run after VerifyApplied, repeat UUID and own Undo/Redo. Create a new camera-isolated PreviewScene using the game's public CreateEditablePreview(..., ImageRich) with the exact persisted task Display.asset and document subasset. The game selects only already-covered existing fonts; missing glyphs fail without asset mutation or invented UI. Verify each actual TMP body/title/caption, RawImage texture/visibility and section order, then Camera.Render to a persistent PNG per section. The uploaded blue/cyan first-section fixture must occupy over ten percent of its projected image element pixels. Close preview in finally, restore selection, verify original scenes, font/material bytes/meta/serialized/dirty state, fixture bytes/meta and unchanged Undo group.
Apply an unsaved body edit only to the task's other document; its saved raw bytes remain unchanged.

Restore only task-owned unsaved edit, then make/save a source conflict to the task asset, immediately run the common processor on the same main thread. Actual receipt must be conflict and must not overwrite the saved conflict content.

Disable actual session; clear any owned dirty fixture; refuse unknown files/GUID/meta changes; clear Undo only for task-created objects; MoveAssetToTrash only the exact task folder and verified newly created image; restore selection. Preserve durable evidence and requests/receipts.
